# Fox News

> Fox News is a news publisher covering the latest breaking news on US, Politics, Donald Trump, World, Entertainment, Sports, Media, Health, and Artificial Intelligence (AI). It also hosts many popular TV shows like The Five, Sean Hannity, Jesse Watters Prime Time and more.

## Breaking News (Main Pages)

- [Home page](https://www.foxnews.com): Fox News Homepage
- [Video](https://www.foxnews.com/video): Lastest videos from Fox News
- [Fox News Live Stream](https://www.foxnews.com/video/5614615980001): Fox News Live Stream

## Main News Categories

- [US](https://www.foxnews.com/us): Breaking News in the United States of America
- [Politics](https://www.foxnews.com/politics): Breaking News in Politics
- [World](https://www.foxnews.com/world): Breaking News around the World
- [Media](https://www.foxnews.com/media): Breaking News in Media
- [Entertainment](https://www.foxnews.com/entertainment): Breaking News in Entertainment
- [Sports](https://www.foxnews.com/sports): Breaking News in Sports
- [OutKick](https://www.foxnews.com/outkick): Culture, Sports, Analysis and Shows by OutKick
- [Lifestyle](https://www.foxnews.com/lifestyle): Travel, Food, Religion, Rare Discoveries and Games
- [Opinion](https://www.foxnews.com/opinion): Opinion Pieces written by Fox News Contributors
- [Health](https://www.foxnews.com/health): Breaking News in Health and Fitness
- [AI](https://www.foxnews.com/ai): Breaking News in Artificial Intelligence (AI)

## Sitemaps

- [XML Sitemap](https://www.foxnews.com/sitemap.xml): Fox News Sitemap
- [XML Fast Changing Article Sitemap](https://www.foxnews.com/sitemap.xml?type=fastchanging): Most recent Fox News Articles
- [XML Fast Changing Video Sitemap](https://www.foxnews.com/sitemap.xml?type=fastchanging-video): Most recent Fox News Videos
- [XML Articles Sitemap](https://www.foxnews.com/sitemap.xml?type=articles): Other recent articles.
- [XML Videos Sitemap](https://www.foxnews.com/sitemap.xml?type=videos): Other Fox News Videos
- [XML Live Blog Sitemap](https://www.foxnews.com/sitemap.xml?type=liveblogs): Fox News Live Blogs

## Robots.txt

- [Robots.txt](https://www.foxnews.com/robots.txt): Robots.txt for FoxNews.com
